data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Alisander, meaning ‘man, helper of the people’. The name Alister is a variation of Alexander, which comes from the Greek ‘alexein’, meaning ‘to help’. The name Alister carries the meaning “Man, helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alister usually hope their child will grow to embody man, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alister total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
